 LIFESTYLE Personal Finance When is your Social Security monthly payment being deposited for November 2026? This is the payment schedule
 Millions of Americans receiving retirement, disability and survivor benefits will get their November payments on different dates
 Social Security Administration LAPRESSE 
 EUAN BURNS (SAM)
 Editor Editor Updated 25/10/2026

 Social Security beneficiaries can now check when their monthly payments are scheduled to arrive in November 2026, with the calendar varying according to the type of benefit received and, for most recipients, their date of birth.
 The Social Security Administration (SSA) follows a regular payment system, but calendar changes can affect the dates.
 Social Security: When is COLA announced, how is it determined and how much can people expect? M.C. November is one such example: Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, November 11, meaning the first regular Wednesday payment group will receive its money a day earlier, on November 10.
 Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients will also receive their November benefit early. Since November 1 falls on a Sunday, the payment is scheduled for Friday, October 30.
 This is an advance payment for November, rather than an additional benefit or a change to the amount recipients are entitled to receive.
 People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997, as well as certain beneficiaries who receive both Social Security and SSI , generally follow a separate schedule. Their Social Security payment is due on Tuesday, November 3.
 The November 2026 Social Security payment dates
 For most people receiving retirement, survivor or Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits, the payment date depends on the birthday of the person whose work record the benefits are based on.
 The SSA divides recipients into three groups, with payments normally arriving on the second, third or fourth Wednesday of the month.
 Those born between the first and tenth of any month are scheduled to receive their November payment on Tuesday, November 10. The date moves forward because the usual second-Wednesday payment day, November 11, is Veterans Day, a federal holiday.
 Beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 11th and 20th can expect their money on Wednesday, November 18. Those born between the 21st and the end of the month are scheduled to receive their payments on Wednesday, November 25.
 These dates apply to eligible recipients whose benefits follow the standard Wednesday schedule. People who qualify for one of the exceptions should check the relevant payment category rather than relying solely on their birthday.
 The November schedule therefore begins with the early SSI deposit on October 30, followed by the November 3 payment for people in the separate early-month Social Security group. The remaining deposits are spread across November 10, 18 and 25.
 Beneficiaries should also remember that a payment arriving in late October may still be intended for November. SSI payments are generally issued on the first day of the month, but when that date falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the SSA normally sends the money on the preceding business day.
 The agency's official 2026 payment calendar is the best reference for checking an individual payment date.
 If a deposit does not appear on the expected date, recipients should first check with their bank or financial institution, as processing times can affect when funds become visible in an account. They can then contact the Social Security Administration if the payment remains missing.
 Knowing the schedule can help households plan around rent, groceries, utilities and other monthly expenses. With the Veterans Day adjustment and the early SSI deposit, checking the correct payment group is especially important for November 2026.
